screensaver.name: steam-trailer-saver

boolean._label: Treat genre list below as a blacklist (hide these genres)

screensaver._description:
Plays Steam game trailers as a fullscreen screensaver, sourced from the Steam store catalog. If Steam has no trailer for a game, a YouTube search is used as a fallback for that game specifically, still filtered by the Steam-derived genre and age-rating metadata.
Note: this panel only exposes simple options because xscreensaver's configuration format has no multi-select widget. For the full genre allow-list/blacklist picker (letting you choose exactly which genres show, rather than typing a comma-separated list here), run:
steam-trailer-saver --configure
Changes made there are shared with this panel's resolution and age-rating settings, since both read and write the same configuration file.
